que_es: Peak pressure of the blood in the arteries with each heartbeat.

como_se_mide_en_vuelo.estacion: Feet in the restraints. Arm still and relaxed. Two readings; record the second.
como_se_mide_en_vuelo.superficie: Seated, cuff at heart level. Two readings; record the second.

por_que: Monitors cardiovascular adaptation and the response to exercise.
referencia_en_vuelo: 24-hour brachial pressure drops by 8 to 10 mmHg after 3 to 6 months on the ISS, with a 39% fall in systemic vascular resistance.
cuando_avisar: Extreme band of layer A (90 mmHg or less; 220 or more), or persistent deviation from the profile baseline.
prevencion: Aerobic and resistance exercise according to the flight plan.
fuentes: The Journal of Physiology, DOI 10.1113/jphysiol.2014.284869 (24-hour brachial pressure in flight)
Royal College of Physicians: NEWS2 scoring table
